sentences.en: Critics may argue that all the foregoing characterizations are very abstract.
sentences.zh: 批评家可能会争论说，上述所有的人物塑造都非常抽象。

sentences.en: The theater company's characterization of Anne Frank was very emotional, but tasteful.
sentences.zh: 这家剧院公司对安妮·弗兰克的人物塑造非常感性，但恰到好处。

sentences.en: The author's characterisation of the villain as a misunderstood loner adds depth to the story.
sentences.zh: 作者将反派刻画成一个被误解的孤独者，为故事增添了深度。
